export const SDKX_KW=new Set("as async await break case catch class const continue debugger declare default delete do else enum export extends false finally for from function if implements import in infer instanceof interface keyof let namespace new null of readonly return static super switch this t\
hrow true try type typeof undefined unique var void while with yield abstract".split(" "));

export const SDKX_RE_AFTER=new Set("return typeof case do else in of new delete void throw instanceof yield await".split(" "));

export const SDKX_PUNCT=[">>>=","...","===","!==","**=","<<=",">>=",">>>","&&=","||=","??=","=>","==","!=","<=",">=","&&","||","??","?.","++","--","+=","-=","*=","/=","%=","&=","|=",
"^=","**","<<",">>"];

export const sdkxTokenize=src=>{const out=[];const n=src.length;let i=0;let prev=null;const idStart=c=>/[A-Za-z_$ -￿]/.test(c);const idPart=c=>/[\w$ -￿]/.test(c);const regexOk=()=>{if(!prev)return true;if(prev.t==="kw")return SDKX_RE_AFTER.has(prev.v);if(prev.t==="p")return!/^(\)|\]|\}|\+\+|--)$/.test(prev.v);return false};const skipStr=(j,q)=>{j++;while(j<n){const c=src[j];
if(c==="\\"){j+=2;continue}if(c===q||c==="\n")return c===q?j+1:j;j++}return n};const skipTpl=j=>{j++;while(j<n){const c=src[j];if(c==="\\"){j+=2;continue}if(c==="`")return j+1;if(c==="$"&&src[j+1]==="{"){j+=2;let d=1;while(j<n&&d>0){const e=src[j];if(e==="'"||e==='"'){j=skipStr(j,e);continue}if(e==="`"){j=skipTpl(j);continue}if(e==="{")d++;else if(e==="}")d--;j++}continue}j++}return n};const push=(t,v,s)=>{
const tok={t,v,s};out.push(tok);if(t!=="ws"&&t!=="cm")prev=tok};while(i<n){const c=src[i];const s=i;if(c===" "||c==="	"||c==="\n"||c==="\r"||c==="\f"||c==="\v"||c==="\xA0"||c==="\uFEFF"){while(i<n&&/\s/.test(src[i]))i++;push("ws",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="/"&&src[i+1]==="/"){while(i<n&&src[i]!=="\n")i++;push("cm",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="/"&&src[i+1]==="*"){const e=src.indexOf("\
*/",i+2);i=e===-1?n:e+2;push("cm",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="'"||c==='"'){i=skipStr(i,c);push("str",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="`"){i=skipTpl(i);push("tpl",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="/"&&regexOk()){let j=i+1;let cls=false;let ok=false;while(j<n){const e=src[j];if(e==="\n")break;if(e==="\\"){j+=2;continue}if(e==="[")cls=true;else if(e==="]")cls=false;else if(e==="/"&&!cls){ok=
true;break}j++}if(ok){j++;while(j<n&&/[a-z]/i.test(src[j]))j++;i=j;push("re",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}}if(/[0-9]/.test(c)||c==="."&&/[0-9]/.test(src[i+1]||"")){const m=/^(?:0[xXbBoO][0-9a-fA-F_]+n?|(?:[0-9][0-9_]*\.?[0-9_]*|\.[0-9][0-9_]*)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?n?)/.exec(src.slice(i,i+64));i+=m?m[0].length:1;push("num",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(idStart(c)){while(i<n&&idPart(src[i]))i++;const v=src.
slice(s,i);const afterDot=prev&&prev.t==="p"&&(prev.v==="."||prev.v==="?.");push(SDKX_KW.has(v)&&!afterDot?"kw":"id",v,s);continue}let p=c;for(let k=0;k<SDKX_PUNCT.length;k++){const q=SDKX_PUNCT[k];if(src.startsWith(q,i)){p=q;break}}i+=p.length;push("p",p,s)}for(let k=0;k<out.length;k++){if(out[k].t!=="id")continue;let j=k+1;while(j<out.length&&out[j].t==="ws")j++;if(out[j]&&out[j].t==="p"&&out[j].
v==="(")out[k].fn=true}return out};

export const SDKX_TOK_CLASS={kw:"sdkx-k",str:"sdkx-s",tpl:"sdkx-s",num:"sdkx-n",cm:"sdkx-c",re:"sdkx-r"};

export const sdkxTokSpan=(t,i)=>{const c=t.t==="id"&&t.fn?"sdkx-f":SDKX_TOK_CLASS[t.t];return c?<span key={i}className={c}>{t.v}</span>:t.v};

export const sdkxLines=toks=>{const lines=[[]];for(let k=0;k<toks.length;k++){const t=toks[k];if(t.v.indexOf("\n")===-1){
lines[lines.length-1].push(t);continue}const parts=t.v.split("\n");for(let j=0;j<parts.length;j++){if(j>0)lines.push([]);const p=parts[j].replace(/\r$/,"");if(p)lines[lines.length-1].push({t:t.t,v:p,fn:t.fn})}}return lines};

export const SDKX_SPACED=new Set(["=","==","===","!=","!==","=>","&&","||","??","?","+=","-=","*=","/=","%=","&=","|=","^=","**=","<<=",">>=",">>>=","&&=","||=","??=","<",">","\
<=",">=","*","/","%","**","|","&","^","<<",">>",">>>"]);

export const sdkxGap=(a,b,a2)=>{if(!a)return false;const av=a.v;const bv=b.v;const ap=a.t==="p";const bp=b.t==="p";const word=t=>t.t==="id"||t.t==="kw"||t.t==="num";const valueLike=t=>!!t&&(t.t==="id"||t.t==="num"||t.t==="str"||t.t==="tpl"||t.t==="re"||t.t==="kw"&&/^(this|null|true|false|undefined|super)$/.test(t.v)||t.t==="p"&&/^[)\]]$/.test(
t.v));if(word(a)&&word(b))return true;if(a.t==="kw"&&!bp)return true;if(a.t==="kw"&&bp&&/^(\(|\{|\[|!|-|\+|~|\.\.\.)$/.test(bv))return!/^(function|super|this|import|null|true|false|undefined)$/.test(av);if(bp&&/^(,|;|\)|\]|\.|\?\.|:)$/.test(bv))return false;if(ap&&/^(,|;|:)$/.test(av))return true;if(ap&&/^(\(|\[|\.|\?\.|!|~|\.\.\.)$/.test(av))return false;if(ap&&av==="{")return bv!=="}";if(bp&&bv===
"}")return true;if(bp&&bv==="{")return true;if(b.t==="kw"&&ap&&/^[)}\]]$/.test(av))return true;if(ap&&av===")"&&word(b))return true;if(bp&&(bv==="("||bv==="["))return ap&&SDKX_SPACED.has(av);if(ap&&(av==="++"||av==="--"))return word(b);if(bp&&(bv==="++"||bv==="--"))return false;if(ap&&(av==="+"||av==="-"))return valueLike(a2);if(bp&&(bv==="+"||bv==="-"))return valueLike(a);if(ap&&SDKX_SPACED.has(av))
return true;if(bp&&SDKX_SPACED.has(bv))return true;if(word(a)&&(b.t==="str"||b.t==="tpl"))return a.t==="kw";if((a.t==="str"||a.t==="tpl"||a.t==="re")&&word(b))return true;return false};

export const sdkxBeautify=toks=>{const sig=toks.filter(t=>t.t!=="ws");const lines=[];const stack=[];let cur=[];let curLen=0;let ind=0;let lineInd=0;let last=null;let last2=null;const nl=()=>{if(cur.length)lines.push(
lineInd?[{t:"ws",v:"  ".repeat(Math.min(lineInd,30))}].concat(cur):cur);cur=[];curLen=0};const put=t=>{if(!cur.length)lineInd=ind;else if(sdkxGap(last,t,last2)){cur.push({t:"ws",v:" "});curLen++}cur.push(t);curLen+=t.v.length;last2=last;last=t};for(let k=0;k<sig.length;k++){const t=sig[k];const nx=sig[k+1];if(t.t==="cm"){if(t.v.indexOf("\n")!==-1){nl();t.v.split("\n").forEach(l=>{lineInd=ind;cur=[
{t:"cm",v:l.trim()}];nl()});last=null}else{put(t);if(t.v.slice(0,2)==="//"){nl();last=null}}continue}if(t.t==="p"){if(t.v==="{"){if(nx&&nx.v==="}"){put(t);put(nx);k++;continue}put(t);stack.push("{");ind++;nl();continue}if(t.v==="}"){stack.pop();ind=Math.max(0,ind-1);nl();put(t);const keep=nx&&(nx.t==="p"&&/^(\)|\]|,|;|\.|\?\.|:|\?)$/.test(nx.v)||nx.t==="kw"&&/^(else|catch|finally|while)$/.test(nx.
v));if(!keep)nl();continue}if(t.v==="("||t.v==="["){stack.push(t.v);put(t);continue}if(t.v===")"||t.v==="]"){stack.pop();put(t);continue}if(t.v===";"){put(t);if(stack[stack.length-1]!=="(")nl();continue}if(t.v===","){put(t);if(curLen>100)nl();continue}}put(t)}nl();return lines};

export const SDKX_TS_PRIM=new Set("string number boolean any unknown never object symbol bigint void undefined null true \
